name: Header

settings.label: Logotype Height Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the header logotype height locally without changing the global base size.

settings.label: Logotype Auto Scale
settings.description: Enables fluid scaling of the logotype or brand component based on available space or screen size. Uses a min/max/scale clamp calculation for smooth mobile adaptation.

componentSettings.label: Layout
componentSettings.description: Controls header spacing and margin presence.

settings.label: Inset Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the inner padding and gap of the header proportionally.

settings.label: Horizontal Margin
settings.description: Enables or disables horizontal (left and right) margin on the header.

settings.label: Vertical Margin
settings.description: Enables or disables vertical (top and bottom) margin on the header.

description: The Header component provides a reusable pattern for header in the interface.
